general: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings to give a tactical dashboard feel.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for coordinates, timestamps, and numerical data.
Ensure the map container takes up the full screen (absolute inset-0) with z-0.
Sidebar and overlays must have a high z-index (z-10, z-20) and use the glassmorphism style defined.
Do NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Stick to rounded-sm or rounded-none for a sharp, professional look.
Use the 'grid_lines' visual enhancer in the background of the sidebar or empty states to add texture.
All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes.
map_integration: Initialize Leaflet map with dark tiles.
Custom markers should use colored circles (divIcon) with a glowing CSS effect (box-shadow).
Red for Severe, Orange for Moderate, Yellow for Mild.
User location marker should be a pulsing blue dot.
charts: Configure Chart.js defaults to have transparent backgrounds.
Use the semantic colors (Red, Orange, Yellow) for data series.

universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients on text. Keep text high-contrast solid colors.
Do not center-align dashboard content. Use left alignment for data readability.
Use 24px-32px padding inside cards to prevent cramping.
Add subtle 1px borders to all panels to separate them from the map background.
Ensure all buttons have a distinct hover state (brightness-110 or bg-shift).
